analysis.reduced_motion_or_nonanimated_equivalent: reduced-motion behavior was not observed; five local states are retained as nonanimated inspection equivalents

interactions.name: Load documentation
interactions.trigger: Navigate to the official documentation URL
interactions.response: The live documentation landing/article surface renders
interactions.feedback: Title and content settle before search
interactions.cancellation: Navigation may be stopped before completion
interactions.failure: Origin or network failure prevents the landing state

interactions.name: Open search or learn route
interactions.trigger: Activate the visible native search control, keyboard convention, or official product search/learn route
interactions.feedback: The surface is visibly distinct from landing
interactions.cancellation: Leave the surface without choosing an answer
interactions.failure: Some book-style sites expose no visible inline search field
interactions.recovery: Use the same product’s official search/result or concept navigation route

interactions.name: Focus query input
interactions.trigger: Target the visible query control when the product exposes one
interactions.response: The product accepts text input or a query-bearing official route
interactions.cancellation: Clear or replace the query before confirmation
interactions.failure: A hidden or absent field cannot accept direct text
interactions.recovery: Continue through the official product result/learn route retained in the recording

interactions.name: Enter impossible query
interactions.response: The product returns an unmatched/failed lookup state
interactions.feedback: The failed state is retained locally
interactions.failure: No useful answer exists for the deliberately impossible query

interactions.name: Cancel failed query
interactions.trigger: Clear or leave the impossible-query route
interactions.feedback: The next product state no longer represents the impossible term
interactions.cancellation: Remain on the documentation surface without selection

interactions.name: Submit learn query
interactions.response: The product renders relevant documentation feedback
interactions.cancellation: Revise the term before opening an answer
interactions.failure: A narrow query can yield no exact match
interactions.recovery: Use the broader recorded product term and official route

interactions.name: Inspect result feedback
interactions.trigger: Wait for the product result/learn surface to settle
interactions.response: Candidate content remains stable for inspection
interactions.feedback: The recovered result state is frozen in a local frame
interactions.cancellation: Return to query/navigation to revise the route
interactions.failure: An empty result surface is not treated as success
interactions.recovery: Follow the captured canonical concept route

interactions.name: Open first answer
interactions.trigger: Activate or navigate from the recovered product route to the first relevant answer
interactions.cancellation: Browser Back is the available post-navigation return path
interactions.failure: A route may land on missing or generic content
interactions.recovery: Return to results and choose the captured canonical answer route

journey.actor: A public documentation visitor looking for one product concept
journey.goal: Reach the first useful Terraform Documentation answer for “providers”
prerequisites: Network access to the official public documentation origin
A Weles-managed real browser on the Stado-selected dedicated host
No account unless the public origin itself imposes a gate

steps.system_response: Render the public product landing/article surface

steps.user_action: Invoke the product search or official learn route
Request the deliberately impossible term zzwissent-no-result-7f3c9
Cancel the failed route and request “providers”
Inspect the first relevant product-owned route
steps.system_response: Keep the candidate state stable for confirmation
Render the first useful documentation answer

failure_route: Request the deliberately impossible term zzwissent-no-result-7f3c9
Observe and retain the no-useful-answer state
recovery_route: Abandon the failed term and request “providers”
Inspect the recovered product result/learn state
journey.completion_evidence: media/state-05-answer.png plus the closing transition in media/motion.webm

observations: The captured query/navigation path was operable through focused controls or official product links without drag-only gestures.
Failure, recovery, and answer feedback remained visually persistent long enough to retain inspectable frames.
unknowns: Screen-reader names, roles, live-region announcements, and reading order were not audited.
Focus styling and focus restoration after cancellation were not independently audited.
Reduced motion, 400% zoom reflow, high contrast, and switch-device access were not tested.

evidence_gaps: accessibility never measured against the product
